mu_name_from: Lorencia's object slot 67, from WorldObjectCatalog.cs. SteelWall runs three from 65 and SteelDoor is one at 68.
why_this_one: 5 placements. A short section, 18 triangles - the piece that closes a run.
sheet_from: Data/Object1/, from MuMain. steel_barred_a and steel_barred_door are .OZT and carry real alpha; steel_barred_b is an opaque .OZJ.
material_note: One material for both sheets, which is unusual here and is right: the bars and the posts holding them are the same iron, drawn on two sheets only because one of them is a shape cut out of alpha and the other is solid.
cutout_from: steel_barred_a.OZT carries a real alpha channel - 85% cut away on the railings, 43% on the gate. A railing is mostly the gaps between its bars.
